messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT — inference-api (us-east-1) error rate jumped to 24% (5m) at 12:03 UTC. Pager: #eng-oncall. Severity: P1. Incident page: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/INC-2026-134

ajay: I'm taking this — I'm on shift. Seeing 5xx spikes on the proxy layer. Starting quick triage.

maria: I got the initial pager but I'm in a meeting with no laptop access for ~30m. Ajay — you have my handoff notes in the oncall doc (link below). If you need my help, ping me and I'll jump in when I can.

sophia: I'm joining as secondary. I can try to warm the fallback model pool and route traffic to the smaller quantized variant. Command I'll run in a sec:

```
# cordon the failing node pool and route traffic to fallback
kubectl -n inference scale deployment inference-worker --replicas=0 --selector=pool=hot
kubectl -n inference scale deployment inference-worker-fallback --replicas=6
# update routing weight
curl -X POST https://console.internal/routing -d '{"service":"inference-api","route":"fallback","weight":80}'
```

ajay: good plan. Before changing routing, let's verify KV cache health and if a rollout caused the spike. Checking recent deploys.

ken: FYI I see a flurry of small model flavor rollouts around 11:58 UTC — looks like a canary batch that didn't fully warm caches. If traffic hit non-warm workers, that could explain the latency/error pattern.

ajay: @deploy-bot — can you share the last 3 deploys for inference-api?

deploy-bot: deploys for inference-api (last 24h):
- 11:50 UTC: rollout model-quant-v2 (canary 10%)
- 11:58 UTC: autoscaler config bump (pod concurrency)
- 12:01 UTC: infrastructure security patch (node drain)

ajay: thanks. The node drain at 12:01 might have coincided with the canary and caused cache misses. Sophia, go ahead with routing to fallback and keep the weight moderate (60-80%).

sophia: started routing change. Observing 503s drop to ~8% within ~90s. Monitoring latency.

IncidentBot: Update: error rate decreased to 9% (12:07 UTC). No new pages for the metric channel.

ajay: quick mitigation helpful — still want to escalate to oncall-exec for visibility and to authorize a small rollback if needed. @oncall-exec please join if available.

oncall-exec: joining. Thanks for the update. What's the ask?

ajay: request approval to rollback the 11:50 canary to cease model-quant-v2 canary and revert to last known-good config. Rollback steps are in the rollback runbook: https://confluence.redwood.example/runbooks/inference-rollback

oncall-exec: approve. Proceed with rollback if the error rate doesn't continue to normalize in next 5m.

sophia: rollback initiated: `deployctl rollback inference-api --to=2026-03-10-2026` — will monitor.

IncidentBot: Rollback job started (job id rb-98765).

ajay: while rollback proceeds, we should note coverage gap: maria was primary but unavailable for the initial window. We'll update the shift log and call out that the primary should confirm reachable device on handoff.

maria: apologies — my meeting ran longer than expected. I'll update the handoff doc with my next-day contact plan.

ken: small operational note: add a line in the oncall checklist to validate that the primary has push notifications enabled and an alternate contact. This was a near-miss.

ajay: agreed. After we wrap this incident, let's do a 10-minute postmortem sync with oncall team to decide whether we need any alert tuning (threshold, cooldown) or routing defaults.

IncidentBot: Rollback completed successfully (rb-98765) at 12:12 UTC. Error rate currently 4% (12:13 UTC).

ajay: looks stable for now. Sophia — can you keep secondary on for 20 minutes to watch metrics and escalate if regressions?

sophia: will monitor. If anything spikes above 10% again, page eng-sre and oncall-exec.

ajay: logging follow-up actions:
- update handoff checklist: verify reachable devices for primary (maria to update)
- add runbook note about concurrent node drains + canary risk (owner: ken)
- consider lowering canary traffic windows or require warm cache check (owner: deploy team)
- scheduled 10-min oncall sync in 30m to capture quick notes

maria: I added my alt contact and call-in plan to the handoff doc: https://docs.redwood.example/oncall/handoffs#maria

ajay: thanks. Closing this thread for the active mitigation. If anyone sees a regression, reopen thread or create a new incident thread.

sophia: :thumbsup: closing monitoring window in 20m.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-134 transitioned to MONITORING at 12:16 UTC. Severity downgraded to P2.

ajay: final note for the record: primary/secondary for next shift (12:30 handoff) — primary: maria, secondary: sophia. Ensure both confirm 5m before handoff.

(End of thread)
